title: Madison Beer Talks About Working With Sean Kaufman For ‘Bittersweet’ Music Video & Explains the Name of Her Album ‘Locket’ | Music You Should Know
summary: Madison Beer talks about working with The Summer I Turned Pretty star Sean Kaufman for her “Bittersweet” music video, explains why she wanted to name her album Locket, why performing at the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show was a dream come true, the writing inspirations behind songs like “Complexity,” “Angel Wings” and “Bad Enough.” Madison Beer […]
